articles.image_title: AfD und Russland: DRUZHKIVKA, UKRAINE - SEPTEMBER 4: A Ukrainian flag attached to an anti-drone net flies in the wind on September 4, 2026 in Druzhkivka, Donetsk Oblast, Ukraine. Since last year, Russian forces have been shelling the settlement around the clock. Before February 2022, up to 67,000 people lived there; now, due to constant shelling and the lack of water, electricity, and gas, only about 3,000 civilians remain. Constant attacks by drones and guided aerial bombs make entering Druzhkivka nearly impossible. The city is on the verge of a humanitarian catastrophe: makeshift graves are appearing in courtyards, while it continues to suffer from constant new destruction and fires. (Photo by Yan Dobronosov/Global Images Ukraine via Getty Images)
